rules.statement: Section 45(1) of the Land Acquisition Act is inapplicable to a case where there would be no buyers in the open market, and compensation should be assessed based on the value of the land as part of the whole property.
rules.supporting_quote: However, it seems to me that the award of Rs. 1,665 for the extent of 9.60 perches acquired is not unreasonable having regard to the figures of comparative sales in the neighbourhood. I therefore consider that even upon the basis which I have adumbrated the compensation is reasonable and that there is no ground for interference with the quantum which could not have been awarded upon a literal reading of section 45 (1).
